providers.plain_description: Choose a recording-level decision threshold from the separate calibration population.
providers.validity_bounds: Unmodified Fitted state and revalidated source configuration. Predict mean window probabilities for calibration recordings without fitting model/scaling. Call the existing generic float64 empirical-F1 provider on one score column and int64 binary labels. Inclusive comparison and highest observed threshold among equal F1 values. Return threshold and calibration count while retaining fitted state. This selects a decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy. Caller owns meaningful subject identities; calibration labels must not be used to train the model.

providers.plain_description: Fit signal scaling and a waveform/spectrogram model using training recordings only.
providers.validity_bounds: Revalidated immutable Prepared configuration. Fixed windows stay within recordings; trailing incomplete samples omitted. Periodic Hann segment-mean-detrended one-sided density PSD with log1p. Recording-balanced training-only channel scaling, constant scales replaced by one. CPU float64 dual 1D waveform/2D spectrogram CNN with frequency-preserving pooling. Seeded time/frequency masks on normalized spectra; class/recording-balanced BCE, Adam and one accumulated update per epoch. All features are materialized in memory; batch size bounds neural forward allocation only. No early stopping, pretrained model, subject-equal weighting or empirical accuracy claim. Trusted model/scaling objects, no portable persistence.

providers.plain_description: Predict query recordings and apply the fitted decision threshold without training again.
providers.validity_bounds: Unmodified Calibrated state. Revalidate configuration, predict ordered mean window query scores and apply the existing inclusive column-threshold provider. Return finite JSON scores/classes/threshold, population and window counts, omitted query samples, epochs and initial/final training loss. Query labels are prohibited. No refit; trusted in-process model state. Predictions are generic binary recording results, not a clinical interpretation, named submission format or independent accuracy claim.

providers.plain_description: Check signal arrays, shared channel layout and disjoint subject populations.
providers.validity_bounds: Exact finite version-1 JSON with training, calibration, unlabeled query and explicit controls. Nonempty rectangular channel/time signals with a common channel count; caller guarantees consistent channel meaning, units and sample rate. Each labeled population has both binary classes. Nonempty subject keys must be disjoint across populations. Validated window/stride/FFT/hop, seed, width, epochs, batch size, learning rate and mask limits. Return detached immutable JSON configuration; no automatic montage or identity discovery.

limits: Offline semantic candidate review, not catalog approval or a human Tier 1 designation.
Two existing generic F1 providers are reused unchanged. Units, population separation, spectral representation, model and aggregation remain recipe policy.
67 synthetic tests cover DFT/PSD numerics, class/recording weights, native execution, F1 oracles and no-refit parity; no clinical or empirical deployment guarantee.
Live catalog reconciliation, original source-scope review, transaction checks and served selection remain required.
